model.name: diagram.addAutoRelationships
model.description: R33.7.2 item-2 INV-AR1 (design 3ace9bf95): adding an element auto-adds its model-derived relationships to on-diagram elements. RIDES the EXISTING DiagramViewModel.buildEdges (8c68b925) - it already draws an edge X<->Y IFF both are on-diagram from model.relations (both directions); addView (70be1605) POSTs add-view then render()->buildEdges re-runs, so a newly-added element's edges to present elements appear by construction. INV-AR1 = model-derived, never fabricated. NO new method/Impl (rides buildEdges + addView). Test credits buildEdges' existing impl (distinct-intent).
